author: Cytokinesis
body:
Add the Looking for Members category to Recent Discussions. Topics in that category don't show up. If those topics appeared in recent discussions I feel that the number of people applying for that team would increase. Unless they're actively looking for a team that's recruiting, most people will overlook this category. 
If this was intentional, I apologize for wasting your time.  Thank you.
